questions.question: A page has images with no alt text, yet `withTags(['wcag21aa'])` reports no violations. Why?
options: axe only checks images when `best-practice` is included
The tag selects only rules added at WCAG 2.1 AA, so the Level A rule for alt text doesn't run
Alt text is a Level AAA requirement
`analyze()` must be called twice to load image rules
questions.explanation: axe tags are exact. To target WCAG 2.1 AA, list `wcag2a`, `wcag2aa`, `wcag21a` and `wcag21aa`.

questions.question: A scan of a page with a closed dialog passes, but the open dialog has an unlabelled input. What should the test do?
options: Add the `experimental` tag
Use `setLegacyMode()` before scanning
Scan twice in a row
Open the dialog, wait for it to be visible, then scan
questions.explanation: axe skips hidden content, so each state has to be on screen when `analyze()` runs.

questions.question: What does it mean when a result appears in `results.incomplete`?
options: axe couldn't decide, so a person needs to review it
The scan timed out before finishing
The rule passed on some elements
The element is excluded from the scan
questions.explanation: Text over a gradient is a typical example, because axe can't work out a single background color. Incomplete results don't fail `expect(results.violations).toEqual([])`.

questions.question: What runs after `new AxeBuilder({ page }).withRules(['image-alt']).withTags(['wcag2aa']).analyze()`?
options: Only `image-alt`
`image-alt` plus every `wcag2aa` rule
Only the `wcag2aa` rules, because the last call replaces the first
Nothing, because the call throws an error
questions.explanation: `withRules()` and `withTags()` set the same option, so the later call wins.

questions.question: Which problem will an axe scan NOT report?
options: An input with no label
Body text with a 2:1 contrast ratio
An image with no `alt` attribute
A clickable `<div>` that can't be reached by keyboard
questions.explanation: axe can't tell that a plain `<div>` is meant to be a control. Use a native `<button>`, and cover keyboard paths with Playwright tests and manual checks.
